title: director.launch/1
description: data/director/launch.json: the launch planner's landing-mix numbers (sim/director/launch.gd; docs/director/landing-mix.md). SLAM DOWN is a drive (down and forward, at an angle set by the target's height); the straight-down slam is its own gated candidate, CRATER SLAM. Heights are in body heights (_bh, 1 bh is 75 units) unless a key says units. Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Orders (lowDeg at most highDeg, lowBh below highBh) and the downward direction of CRATER SLAM and the upward direction of UPPERCUT are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (launch-order, launch-direction); knockBack distances and skid speeds do not fall with the tier (a warning).

drive.description: The SLAM DOWN drive: the angle below level is lowDeg at lowBh or lower, rising evenly to highDeg at highBh and above.

uppercut.description: The UPPERCUT launch direction: ux along the launcher's facing (0 or more), uy up (above 0). The slam lever: the direction was in the planner's code before.

ux.description: Along the launcher's facing; 0 or more.

craterSlam.description: The gated CRATER SLAM candidate: the old straight-down vector (ux, uy) and the two gates that offer it.

ux.description: Along the launcher's facing; 0 or more.

below.description: Gate 1, a rival directly below: the target is within sideBh sideways of the launcher and at least dropBh lower.

setPiece.description: Gate 2, the crater set piece: the launcher is at minTier or above, and throws at most one CRATER SLAM in everySec seconds of match time.

score.description: Planner score points: base + perTier x tier, + high when the target is over highAlt up.

highAlt.description: The target's height above the ground in units (not body heights).

score.description: Its base score against the launch candidates.

distBh.description: How far it sends the rival, in body heights, by the striker's tier 1 to 4.

groundMode.description: On the ground: skid (a low send the ground-contact model skids) or shove (carried back and upright).

skidSpeed.description: The skid's speed by tier, in units a second.

groundWithinBh.description: Within this many body heights of the ground it counts as on the ground.

driftTicks.description: The ticks the shove or the drift carries the rival back.

chain.description: Whether a chain window may open after it.

slideUnderBh.description: The knock-back slides (rather than drifts) when the rival is within this many body heights of the ground.

knockBack.description: The knock-back: a short send that is not a launch across the map (agency-pass.md section 3).

enabled.description: The switch; off, every launch beat goes to the planner as before.

enderAfter.description: A heavy after this many of the string's strikes landed is earned.

cleanTaken.description: A heavy with a stick direction is clean if the striker has taken at most this many blows.

forceMul.description: The launch force of an earned launch.

earned.description: The earned launch (agency-pass.md section 3): a launch beat launches only when earned.
